maintainer.contact: Repository issue / PR tagged app:civicdesk (environment PR #16, @ZichenYuan)

capabilities.ui: business web app (pale.web) plus reviewer renderer

limitations: One member account per instance; no identity verification, attachments to comments or comment withdrawal (absent in the reference).
Notices to Mail are built and published by the host-run publisher after a commit; delivery outcomes reach the comment's notice history only through the comment.notice_recorded Infra event.
Dockets, periods and corrections are App state the task schedules; a period closes by the clock, not by an event, and nothing fires when the clock moves.
No real agency data: agencies, rules and documents are fictional, mirroring the structure of public-domain notices.
